title: Abode Alarm Event Event Code Leaderboard
dataSources: NVR object-detection (`frigate:event`), camera health (`camera:health`), alarm arm/disarm and life-safety (`alarm:event`), lock access (`lock:access`), plate recognition (`plate:detection`), doorbell (`doorbell:event`).
app: Frigate / Blue Iris NVR object-detection events, camera health, alarm and smart-lock logs, and licence-plate recognition via MQTT and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=abode:alarm event_code=*
| stats sum(event_code) as total_value, avg(event_code) as avg_value by zone_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks zone values by total and average event code across Abode alarm event events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `event_code` values for each Abode alarm event event and review total and average event code by zone.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total event code.
grandmaExplanation: It directly which zone shows the biggest event code numbers in your Abode alarm event data.
